facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Manama.
facts.excerpt: Luxury hotel in the heart of vibrant Manama

facts.text: Bahrain Financial Harbour is a five-minute stroll from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Wake up in a spacious room to views across Bahrain Financial Harbor, a five-minute stroll away.

facts.text: The Moda Mall in the Bahrain World Trade Center is a 10-minute walk away.
facts.excerpt: browse upscale brands at The Moda Mall in the iconic World Trade Center, a 10-minute walk away

facts.text: Rooms look out across the harbour.
facts.excerpt: Take in the inspiring views across the harbour and unwind in our stylish rooms

facts.text: Spa InterContinental offers massages and body scrubs, with sauna and steam rooms.
facts.excerpt: Experience soothing massages and revitalizing body scrubs in an atmosphere of calm elegance. Complete your journey with access to our sauna and steam rooms

facts.text: Elements Pool & Lounge is a green oasis in the heart of Manama with daybeds and poolside tables.
facts.excerpt: enjoy a unique moment in a green oasis in the heart of Manama. At our serene Elements Pool & Lounge, you can relax on a daybed with a refreshing beverage, or enjoy the evening breeze from our poolside tables

facts.excerpt: enjoy every bite of your long-lasting breakfast in bed which includes both a Bahraini breakfast and an international one

facts.excerpt: complimentary breakfast, afternoon tea and signature cocktail drinks with the uncompromising service of the Club InterContinental team. Guests enjoy exclusive check-in
